facts.fact: Phil's talking cat tells her he will resolve her problems but first demands breakfast, ordering her to present the buffet.
facts.anchor: Kindly present the buffet

facts.fact: Phil rubs the cat's head; he purrs and arches into her hand.
facts.anchor: Nervously she reached across and rubbed his head

facts.fact: Phil takes her hand off the cat's belly and tells him they are going to pay a visit to the Headmistress.
facts.anchor: pay a visit to the Headmistress

facts.fact: Phil, having decided nobody else deserved to sleep in after her night, knocks on the Head's bedroom-suite door before breakfast.
facts.anchor: But then she somewhat spitefully decided that

facts.fact: Miss Jagerson, the Head, is already up and dressed in beige twinset and pearls, taking tea and toast at a table set for two.
facts.anchor: The Head was already up and dressed, in beige twinset and pearls

facts.fact: Faust the corgi wakes and bounces to his feet, every hair bristling, when Phil's cat enters the room.
facts.anchor: He bounced to his feet, every hair bristling

facts.fact: The Head tells Phil she is personally teaching a handful of sixth-formers, nobody below that level.
facts.anchor: A handful of sixth-formers. Nobody below that level

facts.fact: The Head offers Phil the chance to come back later and have the whole arrangement cancelled and her memory removed.
facts.anchor: It can be arranged.

facts.fact: Alastor is bound to Phil as her servant by the contract she read aloud; she has imposed his cat form on him.
facts.anchor: You have bound me to you with your skilful contract

facts.fact: Faust is the Head's dog and Phil's cat is her new familiar; the Head orders both animals to behave.
facts.anchor: That goes for your new familiar as well, Miss Fen

facts.fact: Anne Bredon came to Grayne's as a Latin teacher; the Head says the school did not know the full details of her private practice.
facts.anchor: as a Latin teacher, we were not aware of the full details

facts.fact: Phil weighs Matron's warning that she must not take more aspirin for another four hours.
facts.anchor: not taking more aspirin for another four hours

facts.fact: Phil recalls that Hesiod wrote the Theogony somewhere around 700 BC.
facts.anchor: written the Theogony somewhere around 700 BC

facts.fact: The Head says the school's current incarnation dates back to the seventeenth century.
facts.anchor: This current incarnation dates back to the seventeenth century

facts.fact: The cat gives his full title as Alastor, Duke of Hell, Executioner of Lucifer.
facts.anchor: I am Alastor, Duke of Hell, Executioner of Lucifer

facts.fact: When the Head asks the cat's name, Phil answers Jupiter.
facts.anchor: she finally said. It was a close enough reference

facts.fact: Phil says she knew the Head left the summoning materials out because the rest of the staff prefer other biscuits.
facts.anchor: Most of the rest of the staff prefer chocolate digestives

facts.fact: The Head says Anne Bredon was removed from her post on the spot once the school found she wanted its resources for her own projects.
facts.anchor: we removed her on the spot

facts.fact: The Head says Grayne's has a line of authority that goes directly to the throne.
facts.anchor: Technically we have a line of authority which goes directly to the throne

facts.fact: Phil gives her full name to the cat as Philomela Fen.
facts.anchor: Philomela Fen.
